definitions: A person who is arrogant and self-important, often displaying an exaggerated sense of their own worth or intellect.
Someone who tries to impress others by pretending to be more important, knowledgeable, or sophisticated than they actually are.
examples: He acted like a pretentious jerk at the party.
Don't be such a pretentious jerk.
I can't stand that pretentious jerk from accounting.
